title: Proposed private qualification review response v1
description: Definition-only candidate IF-BOOK-10 module. Reference response explicitly; the root rejects instances. No JSON request body is defined. purpose_reference.description: Only the applicable recorded booking-purpose and exact notice references needed for this review. No grant/consent decision, history or new authority. Syntax cannot prove that this purpose/notice is current, a booking purpose, lawful or applicable.

snapshot.description: One coherent currently authorized complete six-field snapshot and its committed revision, for permitted pre-intent review only. No lineage-state, edit_base_revision, latest_observed_revision, grant, challenge, provider or operation receipt is delivered. The client creates and preserves its reviewed edit-base binding separately; this snapshot cannot silently rebase dirty work.

error.description: Fixed proposed body-bearing 400/404/503 projections only. No private denial condition, field value, selector, grant or arbitrary diagnostic. Bodyless method/media/size/capacity refusals are transport evidence, not JSON instances.
